video_title: Victor Wembanyama on Mbappé, Messi, and his love for PSG | Men in Blazers

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama on France's early exit from the 2022 World Cup

text_blocks.speaker: Roger Bennett
text_blocks.text: How do you understand what happened with France in the World Cup?

text_blocks.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
text_blocks.text: We didn't play our football. I think it's useless to find excuses. We just didn't have a good game. I think it was mental.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama on his relationship with Kylian Mbappé
quotes.excerpt: For me and every young guy of my generation, he's an icon and inspiration.

text_blocks.speaker: Roger Bennett
text_blocks.text: Can you talk about what Kylian Mbappé is like as a person and what he means to you?

text_blocks.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
text_blocks.text: For me and every young guy of my generation and the next ones, he's an icon and inspiration. Having the chance to meet him is amazing. World-class player.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama on learning to control his environment from Mbappé
quotes.excerpt: An important lesson I could take from who he is is to control your environment.

text_blocks.speaker: Roger Bennett
text_blocks.text: What is the most important thing you've learned from him?

text_blocks.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
text_blocks.text: An important lesson I could take from who he is is to control your environment. He's a guy who's got immense control over his career and who he is.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama on the competitiveness of professional sports
quotes.excerpt: I respect of course competitiveness. If I'm going to be on the court, I want to compete.

text_blocks.speaker: Roger Bennett
text_blocks.text: The coach said he was going to bench him, but Kylian said, 'No, I want to start.'

text_blocks.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
text_blocks.text: I've never been in that situation. I guess you can't really judge until you've been in there, but I respect of course competitiveness. If I'm going to be on the court, or if I'm part of the team, I want to be on the court and compete.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama on the benefits of playing multiple sports
quotes.excerpt: Playing multiple sports and especially football, which is a team sport, a change of direction, a footwork sport.

text_blocks.speaker: Roger Bennett
text_blocks.text: Is there an element of your game where your success comes from your football-filled childhood?

text_blocks.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
text_blocks.text: I agree with all these guys. Playing multiple sports and especially football, which is a team sport, a change of direction, a footwork sport, it's very important and very useful.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama on Lionel Messi's ball-handling abilities
quotes.excerpt: The way he handles the ball and changes direction so quick, it's just amazing.

text_blocks.speaker: Roger Bennett
text_blocks.text: What do you see when you watch Lionel Messi play?

text_blocks.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
text_blocks.text: When I watch him, I know I couldn't do that for sure. The way he handles the ball and changes direction so quick, it's just amazing. He pushes the control you can have over a football to its limits.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama on PSG winning the Champions League
quotes.excerpt: It's great to live in this era where PSG finally won its first and then second Champions League.

text_blocks.speaker: Roger Bennett
text_blocks.text: What does being a football fan bring to your life?

text_blocks.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
text_blocks.text: It brings a lot, especially now that PSG is finally winning the Champions League. It's a lot for myself, as a kid, and also as a Parisian culture, it's amazing. It's great to live in this era where PSG finally won its first and then second Champions League.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Wembanyama on the growth of football in America
quotes.excerpt: If America took football seriously, they could be a problem.

text_blocks.speaker: Roger Bennett
text_blocks.text: What would your message be to new American fans about what football can bring to their life?

text_blocks.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
text_blocks.text: If America took football seriously, they could be a problem. There's already plenty of talents, lots and lots of talents in this country, and I think they're only going to get better.
